name: ASTEEL
recent: ASTEEL 在 2026 年 10 月完成董事会大改组，前全国警察总长 Razarudin 出任主席，Clifford Hii 任执行副主席。公司获得 RM15.8 million 物流合约，并计划多元化进入 IT 服务与贸易，已取得 RM3.5 million 首笔订单。最新季度营收同比增长 20.8%，但净利环比下降 74.6%。
notable: 获得 RM15.8 million 物流合约。
并已取得 RM3.5 million 首笔订单。
董事会改组：Razarudin 任主席，Clifford Hii 任执行副主席。
risks: 最新季度净利环比下降 74.6%，净利率由 1.7% 降至 0.4%。
董事 Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong 的持股出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM83.96 million，同比增长 20.8%，环比增长 4.2%；净利为 RM348,000，同比下降 74.6%，环比增长 146.8%；净利率为 0.4%，上一季度为 1.7%。

recent_en: ASTEEL completed a board overhaul in October 2026, appointing former IGP Razarudin as chairman and Clifford Hii as executive deputy chairman. The company secured a RM15.8 million logistics contract and plans to diversify into IT services and trading with an initial RM3.5 million order. Latest quarterly revenue rose 20.8% year-on-year, but net profit fell 74.6% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Secured a RM15.8 million logistics contract.
Proposed diversification into IT services and trading, with an initial RM3.5 million order secured.
Board overhaul: Razarudin appointed chairman, Clifford Hii appointed executive deputy chairman.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net profit fell 74.6% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin dropping from 1.7% to 0.4%.
Director Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong's shareholding changed.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM83.96 million, up 20.8% year-on-year and 4.2% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM348,000, down 74.6% year-on-year but up 146.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 0.4% versus 1.7% in the previous quarter.
